Package edu.ncsu.csc216.pack_scheduler.catalog

Class CourseCatalog

java.lang.Object
edu.ncsu.csc216.pack_scheduler.catalog.CourseCatalog
public class CourseCatalog extends Object
A class used to hold a catalog of courses at NC State. Users can load and save courses to a file, add and remove courses. as well as get a string of course information from the catalog.
Author:
Shreyash Jain, Liam Yeager

    • addCourseToCatalog

      public boolean addCourseToCatalog(String name, String title, String section, int credits, String instructorId, int enrollmentCap, String meetingDays, int startTime, int endTime)
      Adds a Course with the following fields to the catalog and returns true if the Course is added and false if the Course already exists in the catalog. If there is an error constructing the Course, the IllegalArgumentException is allowed to propagate to the client.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the course
      title - the title of the course
      section - the section of the course
      credits - the number of credits the course is worth
      instructorId - the id of the instructor teaching the course
      enrollmentCap - the enrollment capacity of the course
      meetingDays - the days of the week the course meets
      startTime - the starting time of the course
      endTime - the ending time of the week
      Returns:
      true if the Course is added and false if the Course already exists in the catalog
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any of the fields in the given course is invalid

    • removeCourseFromCatalog

      public boolean removeCourseFromCatalog(String name, String section)
      Removes a course given its name and section from the catalog. Returns true if the Course is removed from the catalog and false if the Course is not in the catalog.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the course to be removed.
      section - the section of the course to be removed.
      Returns:
      true if the Course is removed from the catalog and false if the Course is not in the catalog

    • getCourseFromCatalog

      public Course getCourseFromCatalog(String name, String section)

      Parameters:

      section - the section of the course
      Returns:
      the Course from the catalog with the given name and section.

    • saveCourseCatalog

      public void saveCourseCatalog(String fileName)
      Saves the catalog course records to the given file. Any IOExceptions are caught and an IllegalArgumentException is thrown to the client.
      Parameters:

      Throws:
